objective: Map the whole golf ground with geographically supported shapes, positions and object identities. Cover every requested category; do not equate visually plausible rendering with verified mapping.

categories.gap: Explicit OSM power supports and seven non-tree tagged points used. Unobserved procedural props suppressed; full small-object census and dimensions remain unverified.
Crown candidates and OSM points are different observations, not an additive stem census.
30 individually traced range mats and seven tagged non-tree OSM objects mapped; benches, bins, signs and maintenance equipment still need visible evidence.

Nine 520 m context panels inspected in 2025 imagery. Existing alignments often follow visible corridors, but corner cutting, widths and omitted wooded links remain unresolved; no new road/trail geometry accepted in this continuation.
Six outlines reviewed; other shorelines retain original provenance and topology uncertainties.
Terrain depressions alone do not establish trenches; no new candidate approved.
Existing tagged watercourses retained; all three new valley-filter proposals rejected.
43 municipal footprints adopted; other outlines and most heights remain unverified.
Target footprints do not establish material, poles, distances or individual machinery.
Four aggregate platform footprints and30 individual mats mapped. Surface interpretation and unknown vertical dimensions remain explicit.
NMDv2.0 supplies coarse broadleaf/conifer context, not individual species or new forest boundaries; newer v2.1 equivalence is unverified.
Rock, fence, sign and other small obstacle completeness is unverified.
Three visible bridge decks and a corrected approach mapped. Ten tagged culverts preserved; hidden crossing structures and deck heights remain unverified.
Two additional visible parking areas adopted after review of the five OSM areas; canopy-hidden continuation remains unverified. Vehicles are transient.
Four reviewed greens; full short-game layout still being reviewed.
OSM source retained; widths and junction footprints require review.
Coarse woodland leaf-type dominance informs rendering priors; individual botanical species remain unidentified.

Stora has 53 platform entries: 51 imagery outlines and two provisional originals (H13 and upper H15). All 18 sites reviewed; eight retain partial census status. Mellan has 23 platforms with H8 partial. Daily markers and colours remain unverified.

decisions: Holes8/9 retain three earlier image traces; their complete tee inventory remains unresolved.

storaReview.terrainMethod: geobuild/tee-platform-survey.mjs measures drainage slope and residual planarity separately, with interior/core/edge/exterior coverage. It never automatically adopts polygons or changes terrain.

categories.gap: All 18 Stora greens visually reviewed in 2025 imagery. H16 boundary corrected, removing overlap with sand; H17 previously corrected. Remaining OSM rings retained, with small edge differences unaccepted. All nine Mellan greens have imagery or OSM outlines. Pin positions and absolute accuracy remain unverified.

All 14 Stora par4/5 fairways now have reviewed imagery outlines (12 added in this continuation, plus earlier H13/15). H4 preserves a water gap. Par3 H2/H6/H14 coarse corridor polygons remain unresolved; H10 has none. All six Mellan par4/5 fairways were previously corrected. Seasonal edge changes and absolute accuracy remain unverified.
All86 OSM source IDs tracked; two reclassified and retraced practice bunkers, one grass-covered sand outline retired, five additional range bunkers mapped. Other temporal changes remain to review.
Default rough shading does not count as a mapped mowing boundary.
Tagged landuse polygons retained; current crop and mowing class not verified.
A building footprint alone does not establish use as a cottage.
Seasonal tall-grass boundaries and height require dated evidence.

acceptance: Use terrain for shape, dated imagery for material and visible edges, explicit records for identity.
Retain original geometry and assert it before replacement; record source date, hash, frame and uncertainty.
Measure method performance against independent known objects where available; agreement is not absolute accuracy.
Preserve islands, narrow connections, polygon topology and actual terrain under observed mowing extents.
Update both courses, GIS export, routing/pack bindings and checksum registries after accepted changes.
Commit each substantial completed improvement; completeSurvey remains false while any category has unverified coverage.
mappingStatus: Reviewed improvements adopted; incomplete categories remain explicit and must not be filled with invented geometry.
